rows.name: Other motor fuels

rows.name: Used cars and trucks
rows.liveDriver: SETA02 SA model: rho 0.47 * prior CPI SA +0.40 pp + Manheim m2 signal -0.04 pp * volatility scale 0.35 + level gap z=-0.84, mean-reversion adj +0.02 pp; timing m0 2026-08 unavailable in Manheim feed; m2 2026-06 +0.11% pub 2026-07-07; omitted unavailable m0. Compared against CUSR0000SETA02; no asymmetry term kept. SA forecast converted to NSA using the component's historical SA/NSA offset.
rows.scaffoldDriver: free fallback: recent CPI-timed movement + same-month seasonal average
